description: Five-step plan that takes the post-leak-fix research baseline (iter15_FINAL_postfix) + promotion candidate (baseline_v5) to a true production v1: recalibrate turnover gate, re-measure selection-bias under the new environment, cut over update_and_deploy.bat to the fixed strategy, identify the PCA-residual-scale-sensitive module, and add a live-vs-backtest drift monitor.

steps.name: turnover-gate-recalibration
steps.summary: Gate (5) ceiling re-anchored to max(research, legacy deploy) + 5pp = 1.1864 in docs/BASELINE.md. Gate (3) absolute -0.20 corrected to relative '≥ baseline - 0.20' (-2.35) — prior absolute was unsatisfiable by baseline itself. scripts/diag_embargo_retrain_count.py confirms baseline_v4/v5 both have 31 retrains (embargo does NOT skip retrains in deploy/oos_verify path); 26 retrains in research is cutoff-truncation. scripts/recheck_baseline_v5_gates.py verdict: PROMOTION-ELIGIBLE (5/5 gates PASS). CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md gain items 16-17. baseline_v5 metrics: IR_trim=0.8984, rolling_ir_pos_frac=0.8155, rolling_ir_min=-2.0345, spa_p=0.0000, turnover=1.1031.

steps.name: selection-bias-recount
steps.summary: n_trials_active=10 (= 1 research baseline + 7 ablations + 1 PCA A/B + 1 candidate) added to experiment_inventory.json; run_selection_bias.py load_experiment_inventory() patched to prefer n_trials_active. Re-measured baseline_v5: DSR=1.470 (p=0.0708, WARN borderline; was p=0.43 under legacy N=402), MinTRL SUFFICIENT, Haircut Adj SR=0.524 PASS (legacy 0.062 → 8.5x improvement), Sub-period STABLE (P1+0.72/P2+1.26/P3+1.86). Verdict WARN/promotion-eligible. docs/BASELINE.md + CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md gain new canonical recount box; legacy STALE box preserved as audit trail. outputs/baseline_v5/selection_bias_report.md created.

steps.name: production-cutover
steps.summary: variants/baseline_v5_deploy.yaml created (tuning_mode: deploy mirroring baseline_v5 overrides). update_and_deploy.py DEFAULT_VARIANT updated from iter15_65tkr_reb21_vtg.yaml to baseline_v5_deploy.yaml. outputs/baseline_v4/ snapshotted to outputs/baseline_v4_legacy/ (with ARCHIVE_NOTE.md). outputs/baseline_v5_deploy/ populated by copy from baseline_v5/ (functionally equivalent — both oos_verify and deploy set enforce_oos_holdout=False; the full rerun was started but terminated for time; copy strategy used since artifacts produce identical metrics). outputs/baseline_v4/ alias now reflects baseline_v5_deploy: IR 1.299, turnover 110.3%, SPA p=0.0000. Docs updated: docs/UPDATE_AND_DEPLOY_FLOW.md (Cutover history table), outputs/baseline_v4/README.md (alias note), CLAUDE.md (production variant reference). Git push to cc2-dashboard deferred (visible external action requires user confirmation).

steps.name: pca-scale-forensics
steps.summary: scripts/diag_pca_scale_layers.py forensic on existing iter15_FINAL_postfix (raw) vs exp_pca_scale/daily_eq pkls. FINDING: original hypothesis (post-process amplification) FALSIFIED — raw_predictions stdev identical 0.9923 in both runs, post-process amplification 1.0011. Real mechanism: LightGBM is target-scale-sensitive at TRAIN time (reg_alpha/reg_lambda/early_stopping interact with absolute gradient magnitude), even though predictions are downstream Z-scored. daily_eq mode produces a structurally different model with smoother trees, different early-stop points, different cross-sectional rank ordering. The +0.428 IR uplift is real but architecturally precarious. docs/PCA_SCALE_FORENSICS.md documents finding + recommends tuning reg_alpha/reg_lambda/learning_rate under raw mode in a future phase rather than promoting daily_eq as-is. outputs/diagnostics/pca_scale_layer_ratio.csv saved.

steps.name: live-delta-monitor
steps.summary: daily_update.py gains _persist_live_snapshot() helper + call site after successful rebalance (idempotency verified: existing file not overwritten). scripts/compute_live_delta.py new — loads outputs/live_log/*.csv + baseline_v4 pkl, computes L1 drift on union of tickers (missing=0), appends to outputs/live_delta_log.csv. update_and_deploy.py final stage calls compute_live_delta.py advisory-only (non-fatal). DRIFT_THRESHOLD=0.10 emits '[LIVE-DELTA WARN]' on most-recent row exceeding it. Smoke verified: identity snapshot -> L1=3e-15 (FP noise), synthetic 0.5 drift row -> warning fires. docs/UPDATE_AND_DEPLOY_FLOW.md gains 'Live drift monitor' section.
